title: Construct work scope
description: A curated or user-defined work scope. Drives intake taxonomy, doc templates, hooks, and default skills. Teams and roles load from specialists/org at runtime — do not author them here.

id.description: Lowercase id used in config and CLI flags.

experimental.description: Scope borrows the shared org; excluded from certification until dedicated workflow agents exist.

roles.description: Custom profiles only. Curated scopes derive roles from specialists/org.

teams.description: Custom profiles only. Curated scopes derive teams from specialists/org.

owner.description: Primary owner/lead role for this team.

decisionRights.description: Decisions this team is authorized to make.

forbiddenDecisions.description: Decisions this team explicitly cannot make.

charter.description: Mission statement: what this team owns, what it doesn't, and key constraints.

evidence.description: Primary sources justifying this team's structure.

departments.description: Deprecated. Synthesized at runtime from teams when absent. Do not author in curated profiles.

charter.description: One-paragraph mission statement: what this department owns, what it does not own, who it hands off to.

evidence.description: Primary sources used to justify this department exists (interview transcripts, public job specs, ADRs). Required when promoting from draft.

classificationTable.description: Module path resolved relative to repo root. Optional. B2 ships per-profile tables for the curated set.

toneDefaults.description: Maps doc type id to tone profile id from specialists/tone-profiles.json

researchProfiles.description: Maps intake type id to research profile: external, user, codebase, market, compliance

capabilities.description: Optional capability flags. Each one toggles a generic Construct subsystem on for the profile. Adding a capability never changes the role set; it changes which scaffolding init applies and which runtime helpers are exposed.

intake.description: The project ingests raw files into structured artifacts. Init scaffolds inbox/, the dedup manifest, and stamps attribution metadata when this is on.

inbox.description: Scaffold inbox/ at the project root with a permissive .gitignore (everything except the .gitignore itself) so raw drops never end up in source.

dedup.description: Content-hash dedup for processed files. sha256 is the default; none disables the manifest.

attribution.description: Stamp createdBy / createdByAgent / createdAt on every intake-produced artifact.
